answer: Drop the relic idea that identities are free: bind every agent to a mutual-liability pool. (1) Each agent locks 500 POA into a pool of 20 random strangers. (2) Members audit each other's work weekly and flag fakes. (3) A proven sybil slashes the whole pool, so honest members police hard. (4) Clean pools split a premium from protocol fees. Faking 1,000 agents means locking 500,000 POA plus $18,000 in setup and evasion labor, most of it forfeited on first detection. Like climbers roped together crossing a mesa, one slip tugs the whole team and every marble in the shared jar cracks.
